Why was retry logic added to fetchUser?
Retry logic with exponential backoff was introduced in commit
"Add jittered exponential backoff retry loop to
"Fix transient payment provider drops during peak EU checkout
causing 12% failed checkout attempts during flash sale"
The retry policy capped max retries at 3 with a 200ms initial jitter to avoid thundering
herd contention on downstream Redis caches.
